name: Club dock surfaces: deck boards and screws, black polyethylene floats and rub strips, wooden pilings, the launch ramp
kind: M_WorldSurface patterns 1 (deck), 9 (pilings), 11 (black polyethylene, new) and the concrete pattern 4 with UV1 flag 4 (the ramp)
code: scripts/make_materials.py WORLD_SURFACE_CODE; dkT/dkD lines after `float zw`

scenes.rush creek: AMarinaActor (Ray Hubbard): floating rows and fingers, fixed walkways and piers, pilings, the launch ramps; baked marina tiles hash Age/Care per 4 m of plan, placed kit parts carry E1 custom data 10-15
scenes.coast: ACoastMarinasActor's floating docks use the same Decking and Floats looks
scenes.kit: SM_Dock_Float (Tools/blender/build_docks.py) moves from the Dark slot (MI_World_Tyre) to Floats

levels_needed.L0: honey-tan fresh treated pine, bright zinc screws, satin black floats, green-tan piling with tight cracks, clean grooved ramp
levels_needed.L1: pine starting to dull, first slime line on floats and ramp, a scuff or two on the rub strip
levels_needed.L2: silver-grey boards with brown left in places, dulled screws with black iron stains, mildew clusters, grey chalky floats with a green-brown slime band, cracked silver piling with a dark wet band, green slick at the ramp's water
levels_needed.L3: silver, sound and clean, replaced brown boards among them, wide checks, iron stains; floats chalked but clean; little slime
levels_needed.L4: dark, mildewed boards with green at the gaps and gull droppings; pale chalky floats with a thick slime band and silt; piling dark with algae; ramp green and silted

drivers: dkT = wear.time_k(age), dkD = wear.dirt_k(age, care) from E1 Age/Care (baked tiles: age 0-25 and care hashed per 4 m)
replaces: deck: silvering on age/4 and dark boards on aged x (1-care); pilings: aged; floats: one flat 0.05 black (pattern 0); ramp: plain concrete, no grooves (despite the comment)
maps: none: shader math only, Medium included
out_of_scope: dock boxes and pedestals (pattern 10), galvanized hardware (Metal, pattern 0), steel (pattern 5, the rust lane's), the rest of the world's concrete
